title: 仲量联行CEO：员工对AI的“点头”最危险，但多数人充满好奇
speaker: Christian Ulbrich

segments.en: Have you gotten any pushback internally from within the organization? Is there any place you've tried to implement AI where your employees or leadership has said this really doesn't work?
segments.zh: 公司内部有没有出现抵触情绪？在推行AI的过程中，有没有员工或管理层表示这行不通？

segments.en: I wouldn't say that we had pushback but the pushback would be actually almost positive because then you know who is kind of undermining your effort.
segments.zh: 我不认为我们有抵触，但如果有，那几乎是积极的，因为你能知道谁在暗中破坏你的努力。

segments.en: What is much more dangerous are those people who are nodding and saying that's a great idea and then they return back to their desk and then they do whatever they can that it is not happening.
segments.zh: 更危险的是那些点头称赞，但回到座位后却想方设法让事情无法推进的人。

segments.en: So I like people to be upfront saying they don't like it. But so far I would say people are fascinated because it becomes now through all these kind of clod, it becomes now a citizen thing.
segments.zh: 所以我喜欢人们直截了当地说不喜欢。但到目前为止，我觉得人们很着迷，因为通过所有这些工具，AI已经变得大众化。

segments.en: So they are playing around with those tools for themselves in their leisure time and they are fascinating what it can do and they want to have it in their professional life as well.
segments.zh: 他们在闲暇时间自己尝试这些工具，对其功能感到惊叹，并希望在工作中也能使用。

segments.en: So for the time being I think the majority of people are fascinated by it. Now they are also concerned but frankly within JLL the advantage they have that we are a fast growing organization and even if we drive efficiency that doesn't necessarily mean that jobs will be lost within our organization.
segments.zh: 所以目前我认为大多数人都对它着迷。他们也有担忧，但坦率地说，在仲量联行，我们的优势是公司增长迅速，即使提升效率，也不一定意味着岗位会消失。

segments.en: They may change but they may not be lost.
segments.zh: 岗位可能会变化，但不一定会消失。
